in_marathi.name: Amanat
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amanat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Amanat is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘amara’, meaning ‘immortal’. It is a name of great spiritual significance in Hindu tradition, symbolizing the eternal nature of the soul and the quest for enlightenment.
